record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>; I shall not want<WH02637><WTH8799>.

He maketh me to lie down<WH07257><WTH8686> in green<WH01877> pastures<WH04999>: he leadeth<WH05095><WTH8762> me beside the still<WH04496> waters<WH04325>. <RF>green...: Heb. pastures of tender grass<Rf> <RF>still...: Heb. waters of quietness<Rf>
He restoreth<WH07725><WTH8787> my soul<WH05315>: he leadeth<WH05148><WTH8686> me in the paths<WH04570> of righteousness<WH06664> for his name's<WH08034> sake.

Yea, though I walk<WH03212><WTH8799> through the valley<WH01516> of the shadow of death<WH06757>, I will fear<WH03372><WTH8799> no evil<WH07451>: for thou <FI>art<Fi> with me; thy rod<WH07626> and thy staff<WH04938> they comfort<WH05162><WTH8762> me.

Thou preparest<WH06186><WTH8799> a table<WH07979> before<WH06440> me in the presence of mine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>: thou anointest<WH01878><WTH8765> my head<WH07218> with oil<WH08081>; my cup<WH03563> runneth over<WH07310>. <RF>anointest: Heb. makest fat<Rf>

Surely goodness<WH02896> and mercy<WH02617> shall follow<WH07291><WTH8799> me all the days<WH03117> of my life<WH02416>: and I will dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> for ever<WH0753><WH03117>. <RF>for ever: Heb. to length of days<Rf><CM>
